_note: The rules the new regime does not allow, by S2 s.202(2)(a) / 1961 s.115BAC(2)(i) (D-165, D-166) — one set, referenced by NEW_TAX_REGIME, shared by any later regime the same words cover (DR 10 E3.5). Each version lists the rules its year holds that rest on the provision: professional tax ((a)(iv); 1961 s.16(iii)); Chapter VIII ((a)(xii); 1961 Chapter VI-A, not 80CCD(2), 80CCH(2)); HRA and LTA ((a)(i), Sch. III Sl. 11, 8; 1961 s.10(13A), (5)); CEA, hostel, uniform ((a)(ii), not prescribed by S4 r.280(3); 1961 s.10(14), not in r.2BB(3)); own-residence interest ((a)(v); 1961 s.24(b) for s.23(2), with the pre-construction share in TY 2025-26 only — TY 2026-27 allows s.22(1)(c), D-156); a Government employee's entertainment allowance (1961 s.16(ii), TY 2025-26 only). Rows the regime keys rather than forbids stay ExceptIn: SAL-STANDARD-DEDUCTION-ANY-OTHER-CASE, DED-NPS-EMPLOYER-OTHER, PERQ-MEAL-VOUCHER (TY 2025-26).
